description_en: Queries the information about a deployment package
description_zh: 调用GetDeploymentPackage获取发布包的详情
name: GetDeploymentPackage

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the ID. This parameter identifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace. This is the identifier shown in the workspace switcher at the top of the Data Studio page.

Either this parameter or ProjectId must be specified to determine which DataWorks workspace this API call operates on
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。


该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The deployment package ID. This ID is generated when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html
parameters.help_zh:
发布包的ID。
执行https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html 和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html时，都会生成一个对应的发布包ID
parameters.name: deployment_id

Status.description_en:
UNPUBLISHED(0)

SUCCESS(1)

ERROR(2)

CLONED(3)

DEPLOY_ERROR(4)

CLONING(5)

REJECT(6)
Status.description_zh:
UNPUBLISHED(0): 未发布

SUCCESS(1): 发布成功
ERROR(2): 发布失败
CLONED(3): 克隆成功
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): 发布失败
CLONING(5): 克隆中
REJECT(6): 发布驳回

CheckingStatus.description_en:
The validation status of nodes in the deployment package. For packages deployed to the development environment (toEnviroment=1), you can only proceed to deploy to production if the package Status is 1 (succeeded) and CheckingStatus is empty (validation complete).

7: Validation failed

8: Validation in progress
CheckingStatus.description_zh:
当前发布包涉及节点的检查状态，
当发布包的目标环境是开发环境（toEnviroment=1）时，只有发布包的Status为1并且CheckingStatus为空时，才可以继续进行文件到生产环境的发布。
7：检查未通过
8：正在处于检查中的状态

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp (in milliseconds) when the deployment package was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
发布包生成的毫秒时间
戳

CreatorId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who created the deployment package
CreatorId.description_zh:
发布包创建者的阿里云
用户ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The detailed error message when the deployment package fails (status is 2)
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
当发布包执行失败（status为2）后，
该字段记录具体的错误信息

ExecuteTime.description_en: The timestamp (in milliseconds) when the deployment started
ExecuteTime.description_zh:
发布包开始执行的毫秒时
间戳

FromEnvironment.description_en: The environment where the deployment is executed. Valid values: 0 (local) and 1 (development)
FromEnvironment.description_zh:
执行本次发布所在的环境
，包括0（本地）和1（开发环境）

HandlerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who executed the deployment
HandlerId.description_zh:
发布包执行者的阿里云用
户ID

Name.description_en: The deployment package name, displayed on the Deploy Center > Deployment Packages page
Name.description_zh:
发布包的名称，
显示在任务发布>发布包列表页面

Status.description_en: The current status of the deployment package. Valid values: 0 (ready), 1 (succeeded), and 2 (failed)
Status.description_zh:
发布包当前的状态
，包括0（就绪）、1（成功）和2（失败）

ToEnvironment.description_en: The target environment for the deployment. Valid values: 1 (development) and 2 (production)
ToEnvironment.description_zh:
发布文件信息的目标环境，
包括1（开发环境）和2（生产环境）

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call succeeded. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
